tools.name: list_build_and_publish_skill_files
tools.title: List Build And Publish Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the SEMOSS 'build-and-publish' skill, the platform's guidance for compiling and publishing a React app after editing client source. Call this when the user asks to build, rebuild, compile, publish, or deploy an app, or when a turn has just edited client code and needs to be built. Explains that BuildAndPublishApp is the only supported build path, that node/npm/pnpm are blocked in the sandbox, and when to use PublishProject(project, release=true) for already-runnable portal assets. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md.

project.title: project
project.description: The build-and-publish skill (build-and-publish). Always this value.

tools.name: read_build_and_publish_skill_file
tools.title: Read Build And Publish Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the SEMOSS 'build-and-publish' skill in full, before building or publishing an app. Pass filePath exactly as list_build_and_publish_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers when to build versus skip, how to invoke BuildAndPublishApp, publishing without building, what never to run, and what to do when a build fails.

project.description: The build-and-publish skill (build-and-publish). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_build_and_publish_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
